ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_NATIONALITY_CRM] AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_Nationality
AS(
    SELECT
	
     BCC.[VALUE] AS NationalityId
    ,BCC.DESCRIPTION  AS NationalityName
	,NULL AS NationalityDescription
    ,BCC.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BCC.CATEGORYID AS CategoryId
    ,'CRM' AS SourceSystemCode
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES BCC
WHERE BCC.CATEGORYID IS NOT NULL
AND BCC.ISLATEST = 1 AND CATEGORYTYPE = 'NATIONALITY'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_Nationality FROM TEMP_BNKM_Nationality;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_Nationality_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,NationalityId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,NationalityName)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,NationalityDescription)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,FinancialInstitutionId)
,CONVERT(INT,CategoryId)
)) HASHROW, NationalityId,FinancialInstitutionId,CategoryId
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_Nationality 
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_Nationality_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,NationalityId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,NationalityName)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,NationalityDescription)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,FinancialInstitutionId)
,CONVERT(INT,CategoryId)
)) HASHROW, NationalityId,FinancialInstitutionId,CategoryId
FROM BNKM.Nationality WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_Nationality_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.NationalityId,TGT.NationalityId) AS NationalityId
	,ISNULL(SRC.CategoryId,TGT.CategoryId) AS CategoryId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_Nationality_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_Nationality_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CategoryId = TGT.CategoryId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.NationalityId = TGT.NationalityId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_Nationality_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_Nationality_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT 
SET
NationalityId = SRC.NationalityId
,NationalityName = SRC.NationalityName
,NationalityDescription = NULL
,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,CategoryId = SRC.CategoryId
FROM BNKM.Nationality TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_Nationality_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.NationalityId = TGT.NationalityId AND DELTA.CategoryId = TGT.CategoryId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_Nationality SRC ON SRC.NationalityId = TGT.NationalityId AND SRC.CategoryId = TGT.CategoryId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
WHERE TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'	;
 

----INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.Nationality
([NationalityId]
,[NationalityName]
,[NationalityDescription]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[CategoryId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT
	SRC.NationalityId AS NationalityId
	,SRC.NationalityName AS NationalityName
	,NULL AS NationalityDescription
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,SRC.CategoryId AS CategoryId
	,'CRM' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_Nationality SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_Nationality_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.NationalityId = SRC.NationalityId 
AND DELTA.CategoryId = SRC.CategoryId 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_Nationality;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_Nationality_DELTA;

END
